## 🛡️ Pull Request Overview

### Description
Provide a concise summary of the changes made and the motivation behind them.

### Related Issues
Fixes #(issue number)

---

### Type of Change
- [ ] 🐛 Bug fix (non-breaking change fixing an issue)
- [ ] ✨ New feature (non-breaking change adding new security policy or CLI flag)
- [ ] 💥 Breaking change (fix or feature causing existing functionality to change)
- [ ] 📚 Documentation update

---

### Checklist
- [ ] My code follows the code style guidelines of this project.
- [ ] I have added automated unit/integration tests covering my changes.
- [ ] All existing and new tests pass locally (`npm run test:all`).
- [ ] I have updated relevant documentation / README if applicable.
